Adult Cat Feeding Instructions: Fill your cat's bowl with the recommended measured amount every morning and allow your cat to eat on a "free choice" basis throughout the day, rather than as a single feeding at mealtime. Food intake required to maintain an ideal body condition will vary, depending on age, activity and environment. Monitor your cat's weight and adjust food amount accordingly. Feed Only One: A cat's digestive system works best when it receives the same food each day. Although humans crave variety in their diets, cats do not. Feeding different cat foods can turn your cat into a finicky eater and may lead to obesity. For questions related to the health of your cat, see your veterinarian. It's Not for All Cats: Purina ONE LiveClear Allergen-Reducing Formula With Real Chicken #1 Ingredient is specifically formulated for adult cats. If you have a kitten, or a pregnant or nursing cat, feed Purina One LiveClear Allergen-Reducing Kitten Formula. Making the Switch to Purina One: Although you'll be anxious to see the difference Purina One can make in your cat, please allow 7-10 days to ease the transition from your cat's current food. Each day, simply feed a little less of the previous food and a little more Purina One until you're feeding Purina One exclusively. This gradual transition will help avoid dietary upsets. No Supplements Necessary: Purina One provides 100% complete and balanced nutrition for maintenance of adult cats. There is no need to add vitamins, minerals or other supplements, unless specifically directed by a veterinarian. Fresh Water, Proper Diet & Veterinary Care: Be sure to provide fresh water in a clean container for your cat daily. Proper diet, exercise and veterinary care are the best ways to keep your cat healthy. If your cat hasn't had a check-up in the past year, please make an appointment today.

Regular regurgitation may indicate a more serious issue, and you should consult your veterinarian.

Cats can be very good at hiding what’s ailing them. However, you can find clues in their litter box. Lots of stinky stools could mean your cat has a sensitive stomach and digestive tract. Sometimes regurgitation can be an indicator that your cat is eating too fast to even digest and absorb the nutrients they need. Regular regurgitation may indicate a more serious issue, and you should consult your veterinarian.

Royal Canin Digestive Care dry cat food is made for cats with sensitive stomachs that tend to scarf down and regurgitate their food. The exclusive ring-shaped cat kibble encourages your cat to slow down and chew thoroughly. And highly digestible proteins, including a blend of prebiotics and dietary fibers, help balance the intestinal tract for healthy digestion. This precise diet is proven to be effective after 10 days with over 95% healthy stool quality. Try pairing with Royal Canin Digest Sensitive wet cat food formulas for a meal your cat will love.

Directions for Mixing KMR Powder: Gently stir or shake 1 part powdered KMR into 2 parts warm water (a part may be a teaspoon, tablespoon or cup). Do not mix more KMR than can be consumed in 24 hours. Do not use a blender. Reconstituted KMR should be kept refrigerated. One 12 oz. (340g) can of powder makes approximately 60 oz. (1.7L) of liquid mixed 1:2. Directions for Feeding: All kittens should receive their mother's milk for at least 2 days, if possible. This colostrum milk gives extra nutrition and temporary immunity against some diseases. Warm reconstituted KMR to room or body temperature before serving. Feed kittens 2 tablespoons (30mL) of liquid KMR per 4 ounces (115g) of body weight daily. The daily feeding amount should be divided into equal portions for each feeding. Kittens' needs will vary and this amount may have to be increased or decreased depending on the individual. Young and/or weak kittens should be fed every 3 to 4 hours. Older kittens can do well being fed every 8 hours. Weigh the kittens 3 times per week to assure adequate feeding. Consult your veterinarian for additional advice. The PetAg 2 oz. (60mL) small Animal Nurser is suited for feeding most kittens. When kittens are old enough to lap, begin offering reconstituted IVAR in a saucer. During the 5th week mix reconstituted KMR with KMR 2nd step Kitten Weaning Food. Use of the KMR and 2nd Step will allow the kitten to be gradually switched to solid food. Pregnant and lactating queens: Feed 2 teaspoons (4g) KMR Powder per 5 lbs. (2.2kg) body weight daily. Growing kittens already on solid food, show cats, and/or convalescing cats: Feed 1 teaspoon (2g) KMR Powder per 5 lbs. (2.2kg) body weight daily by top dressing food. Storage: Unopened powder should be stored in a cool, dry place. Reconstituted liquid must be kept refrigerated for up to 24 hours. Opened powder must be refrigerated for up to 3 months, or can be frozen for up to 6 months to preserve freshness. Use before date stamped.

sections.bodyString: Here at Inaba, we know your cat is a beloved family member. That's why each of our Churu Lickable Creamy Purée Natural Cat Treats are made from high-quality ingredients, including wild-caught tuna and farm-raised chicken. Since cats are not naturally drawn to water, we have made these a high-moisture, low calorie cat treat that your kitties will love. They contain 91% moisture and have only 6 calories per tube. That's a tenth of the calories of traditional dry cat treats and more than 1000 times the moisture (8% vs. 91% moisture). In addition, we've also added Taurine to help with their vision, digestions and heart health, as well as, Vitamin E for immunity and Green Tea Extract for its natural antioxidants. What they're missing? They're grain-free, preservative-free, carrageenan-free and free from artificial colors, making them a cat treat you can feel good about feeding. sections.bodyString: Modern science proves that your dog shares the DNA of the wolf. Directions for Feeding: Esbilac 2nd Step should be lapped out of a bowl, not fed from a bottle. Esbilac 2nd Step has been formulated to meet the nutritional needs of young puppies being weaned from mother, or bottle fed puppies progressing to solid foods. For best results the product should be mixed with ready to feed liquid Esbilac or reconstituted powder Esbilac to give the consistency necessary to get good food consumption. If Esbilac is not available water may be used. Fresh, clean water should always be available for drinking. It is recommended that Esbilac 2nd Step be fed until puppies are seven or eight weeks old when they can be fed commercial puppy or dog food as desired. All changes in diet should be made gradually over a period of one week. Mixing Directions: Puppies that are up on their feet and lapping from a bowl may be introduced to Esbilac 2nd Step. Begin by offering it as a thin gruel. Determine the amount of Esbilac 2nd Step powder to be fed to the puppy at each feeding using the Feeding Guidelines below. Reconstitute powder by using three parts (a pad is any measuring device, i.e. teaspoon, tablespoon or cup) liquid Esbilac or water to one pad powder for the first few days. Offer only small amounts and remove the uneaten portion after no more than 20 minutes. Puppies should be fed three times per day. Weigh the puppies at least once a week to monitor weight gain and adequacy of feeding. As puppies grow, decrease the amount of water mixed with the powder until weaning food is an oatmeal consistency. Consult your veterinarian for additional advice. Feeding Guidelines: Feed puppies three times per day. Small puppies (1 lb average): 1 tablespoon powder. Medium puppies (3 lb average): 4 tablespoon powder. Large puppies (5 lb average): 5 tablespoon powder. More or less food may be needed by individual puppies to satisfy their food requirements for optimum performance. Storage: Powder does not need to be refrigerated, but should be kept covered and stored in a cool, dry place. Avoid exposure to excessive temperatures. Use before date stamped.

For Mixing Goats Milk Esbilac (GME) Powder: Gently stir or shake 1 part powdered GME into 2 parts warm water (a part is a teaspoon, tablespoon or cup). Do not mix more GME than can be consumed in 24 hours. Do not use a blender. Reconstituted GME should be kept refrigerated. One 5.25 oz (150 g) can of powder makes approximately 20 oz (600 ml) of liquid mixed 1:2. For Feeding: All puppies should receive their mother's milk for at least 2 days, if possible. This colostrum milk gives extra nutrition and temporary immunity against some diseases. Warm reconstituted GME to room or body temperature before serving. Feed puppies 2 tablespoons (30 ml) of liquid GME per 4 ounces (115 g) of body weight daily. The daily feeding amount should be divided into equal portions for each feeding. Puppies' needs will vary and this amount may have to be increased or decreased depending on the individual. Young and/or weak puppies should be fed every 3 to 4 hours. Older puppies can do well being fed every 8 hours. Weigh the puppies 3 times per week to assure adequate feeding. Consult your veterinarian for additional advice. The PetAg 2 oz (60 ml) or 4 oz (120 ml) small animal nurser are suited for feeding most puppies. When puppies are old enough in lap, begin offering reconstituted GME in a saucer. During the 5th week mix reconstituted GME with Esbilac 2nd Step puppy weaning food. Use of the GME and 2 step will allow the puppy to be gradually switched to solid food. Pregnant and lactating bitches: feed 2 teaspoons (4 g) GME powder per 5 lbs (2.2 kg) body weight daily. Growing puppies already on solid food, show dogs, and/or convalescing dogs: feed 1 teaspoon (2 g) GME powder per 5 lbs (2.2 kg) body weight daily by top dressing food. Storage: Unopened powder should be stored in a cool, dry place. Reconstituted liquid must be kept refrigerated for up to 24 hours. Opened powder must be refrigerated for up to 3 months, or can be frozen for up to 6 months to preserve freshness. Use before date stamped on top or bottom.

sections.bodyString: We made the first puppy pads that actually train puppies, not just catch their pee. Our SmartStart Puppy Pads guide puppies to the right spot with colors they can see and an attractant that brings them back. That means faster learning, fewer accidents, and way less frustration. sections.bodyString: We're always looking for new ways to make a better dog pad. And so when our engineers tested activated charcoal, they knew we had something special. Turns out the same stuff that filters water and purifies air also destroys dog pee odors like crazy. Our CarbonLock technology safely combines activated charcoal with rapid absorption to pull pee inside-10 cups!-lock it away permanently while neutralizing odors at the source. And as long as we were making this odor-destroying pad, why not make it larger? How about a full 7 square feet of coverage - no fragrance needed when charcoal's at work! Exciting bonus: Our full-length sticky strips keep this pad exactly where you put it (but lift off easily without leaving any residue), and the sophisticated heather gray color means it actually looks good on your floor.

OK, first…deep breath, you two, repeat after us: "this is the process". Unfold a pad on floor away from your dog's food and bed with the grey plastic side down, white absorbent side up. Give your dog time to smell it (don't ask, that's how they do it). Give encouragement when they're using the pad (it's like a kid on a toilet, right?). Praise and reward with treats (it's a big moment for both of you!). Repeat. Deep breathing. Every few days, move the pad closer to the outside door (see where we're going with this?) and before you know it you can move the pad outside, which means it's time for both of you to celebrate!

name: Pet Life Unlimited Charcoal Powered Dog Pads

sections.bodyString: Did you know your dog's pee has something to tell you? And now finally, there's a dog pad that helps you listen. With patent-pending technology, our pad instantly measures your dog's urine pH and changes color accordingly. This gives you a heads up about a potential UTI, bladder, kidney or urinary health issue before they become problems. No color change after your dog pees? Everything's good. Pee spot turned purple? Might be worth a call to the vet. This pad has the superior leak-proof absorbency as our other pads, locking in a whopping 6 cups of pee, so you never have to worry about your floors or your pup.

The first three days, feed a mixture of 3/4 current food and 1/4 Encore Premium Food. The next three days, feed 1/2 current food and 1/2 of Encore Premium Food. It takes a lot of energy to fly, so they're always looking for their next meal. This is why it's so easy to attract wild birds with seeds and blends. Birds will frequent your feeders more often and stay longer if you provide a consistent, reliable source of high-energy seeds and blends from Kaytee; Provide a Source of Fresh Water: Water is also very important for wild birds. They use it to clean their feathers and for drinking. Birds will also stop more often and stay longer if you can give them a source of fresh water like a bird bath, garden pond or fountain. Running water works best because birds can hear it, and it's easier for them to use if it's three inches deep or less; Place Feeders Near Shrubs and Trees for Cover: Wild birds are always at risk of predation. When they're at the feeder they spend more time looking out for hawks and other predators than they do feeding. Placing feeders near trees or shrubs offers them protection. Wild birds use trees and shrubs to escape and hide from predators, to rest and sometimes to nest. They will be happier using your feeders when you place them close to cover. Directions for Use: Keep feeders filled with fresh food. Discard old food before refilling and clean feeders regularly to minimize mold and bacteria. Care & Feeding Instructions: When introducing a guinea pig to a new food, begin with a mixture of the old and new foods, gradually increasing the amount of new food over a 7 to 10 day period. This will prevent digestive upsets as well as allowing your pet to adjust to smoothing new. The following feeding amounts can be used as a starting point and should be adjusted to maintain a guinea pig's proper weight. The portions shown below are for one guinea pig. Adjust the amount if additional guinea pigs are fed. Daily Feeding Amount: Guinea Pig: 1/4-1/2 cup. Other Keys to Keeping a Healthy Guinea Pig: Keeping clean water is an essential component of a good pet care program. Clean cage at least weekly. Guinea pigs must have a proper amount of vitamin C in their diets so Timothy Complete is packed with long-lasting vitamin C. Storage Instructions: For maximum freshness, store in a cool dry location. Reseal between each use. Refrigerate or freeze for extended storage.

High in fiber yet naturally low in protein and balanced in calcium, Orchard Grass supports digestive health and helps maintain proper dental wear in small herbivores. The long strands of hay encourage essential chewing activity, which helps prevent overgrown teeth and promotes a healthy digestive system. As the cornerstone of small pet nutrition, Orchard Grass Hay can be offered in unlimited amounts to support overall well-being. Beyond nutrition, Orchard Grass Hay adds variety and enrichment to your pet's environment.

Feeding guide: Remove foil seal and tray. Drop feeding block(s) into the aquarium. See chart for number of blocks recommended. Depending on the number of fish in your tank, the feeder block might not be fully consumed when you return from vacation. The feeder does not disintegrate on its own; food is released as fish nibble on the block. If there is food left you can leave the block in the tank and resume normal feeding regimens (i.e. TetraMin®). If you keep particularly large, hungry fish such as loaches or large Cichlids you can add another feeding block to the recommended amount. For fish used to eating at the surface (top/mid feeders), try breaking off a bit of the gel block prior to dropping it into the aquarium. Once the block has settled at the bottom, release the remaining, broken-off piece directly over where the block is positioned so that fish can locate the temporary food source. sections.bodyString: Pristine uses bio-augmentation, a non-chemical and natural method, to improve water quality. It will also reduce excess nutrients (e.g. ammonia, nitrates, and nitrites) that may fuel the growth of nuisance and disease-causing organisms. Pristine increases water clarity and promotes overall better health for the aquatic environment. The species of bacteria in Pristine are a unique blend, specifically developed for hardiness and their ability to adapt to a wide variety of environmental conditions. They thrive in fresh or salt water and can utilize a wide range of organic compounds, including fats that can cause unsightly films. Unlike traditional nitrifying bacteria, this bacterial blend can adapt to harsh or low oxygen environments and continue to multiply and improve water conditions. Biopolymers produced by established bacterial colonies trap particulates and increase water clarity.

sections.bodyString: The Exo-Terra Reptile UVB 100, 13W has a moderate to high UVB output, similar to that of shady environments such as rain forests and other tropical locations. Reptiles living in these habitats receive less UV radiation because of the many climatological conditions (fairly high humidity, changes in weather, etc) that prevent direct sunlight from reaching them or their basking sites. The advantage of the Exo Terra Repti Glo Compact Fluorescent bulb is its size and the fact that it is self-ballasted. A regular screw fitting is sufficient to operate these bulbs. The spiral shape of the bulb enables vertical or horizontal mounting without compromising performance. It is recommended to combine a high UVB output (Repti Glo 5.0 and 10.0) with a very high visual light output (Repti Glo 2.0) for optimal results. Fluorescent bulbs do not provide sufficient heat. A separate heat source is required in addition (ex: incandescent basking lamp).

name: Exo Terra Reptile Light Bulb
